local function phase1()
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local expected=nil
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse)
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   local id=item.recordId
   expected[id]=player:countOf(id)+source:countOf(id)
   local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
   print('Sewer corpse item '..id..' count '..source:countOf(id)..' name '..(record and record.name or '?'))
  end
  print('Sewer loot observer ready dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(corpse)))
 end
 if done then return end
 local n=0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do
  n=n+1
  if source:countOf(id)~=0 or player:countOf(id)~=count then return end
 end
 if n>0 then done=true print('Sewer corpse loot transferred types='..n) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local self=require('openmw.self')
local ready=false
local x=false
local y=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not ready then ready=true print('Fresh standback ready') end
 local p=self.position
 if not x and p.x>=730 then x=true print('Fresh standback east reached '..tostring(p)) end
 if not y and p.y<=-200 then y=true print('Fresh standback south reached '..tostring(p)) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase3()
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local expected=nil
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse)
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   local id=item.recordId
   expected[id]=player:countOf(id)+source:countOf(id)
   local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
   print('Sewer corpse item '..id..' count '..source:countOf(id)..' name '..(record and record.name or '?'))
  end
  print('Sewer loot observer ready dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(corpse)))
 end
 if done then return end
 local n=0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do
  n=n+1
  if source:countOf(id)~=0 or player:countOf(id)~=count then return end
 end
 if n>0 then done=true print('Sewer corpse loot transferred types='..n) end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2,phase3}}
local n=1
local current=phases[n]()
local pressed=false
print('Continuous observer phase 1 ready')
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local now=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if now and not pressed then
  n=n+1
  assert(phases[n],'Unexpected observation phase')
  current=phases[n]()
  print('Continuous observer phase '..n..' ready')
 end
 pressed=now
 if current.engineHandlers.onFrame then current.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt) end
end}}}}
